title: Intent-Journey Map prop-contract
description: The machine half of an Intent-Journey Map: the prop-contract (the machine companion to the system-and-data and UI-and-component bands, at Tier 2), one object per data prop, the 14 columns as fields. Version 1.0, additive thereafter. The boundary is machine-enforced: research_question is null by construction, open decisions carry an owner but no resolution, and additionalProperties:false keeps any verdict, score, or gate field out. HeyHi Confidential.

feature.description: The feature this contract belongs to. Generic label; no client name (hermetic seal).

generated_at.description: ISO date the contract was produced.

tier.description: The IJM tier. The prop-contract is emitted at Tier 2; a Tier-1 contract is a partial (bands 1/2/4/5 only).

architecture_target.description: As stated in the brief or the manifest. Null when unstated.

domain_band.description: The pluggable domain-state band in use, or null for a plain flow.

research_question.description: Null by construction. The research question behind the feature is a human judgment (SKILL.md Step 6, the empty slot). A non-null value fails validation.

open_decisions.description: Every decision the map surfaced and could not settle. Each carries a named owner and no resolution: the resolution is the human's, behind the named gate.

step.description: Column 1. The map step this prop serves.

screen_state.description: Column 2. The Given/When/Then label from band 5.

component.description: Column 3. Served-library name plus atomic level, or 'NEW: name'.

prop_role.description: Column 6. data, presentation (a token value), or behavior (a callback).

type.description: Column 7. The type, bound to an OpenAPI schema slice when the binding resolves.

source.description: Column 8. The data hook and endpoint; both null for presentation or behavior props.

json_pointer.description: Column 9. JSON pointer into the application's OpenAPI. Null when there is no owned spec to bind against (binding_status: no-spec) or the prop is not a data prop.

binding_status.description: Column 9, the honesty field. bound = the pointer resolved. flagged-absent = the pointer did not resolve (a finding). no-spec = the application has no OpenAPI; bound to a typed module or external endpoint instead. assumption = a human-asserted field the sources do not support.

required.description: Column 10. From the schema 'required' array; null when unbound.

enum.description: Column 11. From the schema enum; asserts equality with the token or variant set when the prop drives one. Null when none.

default_or_token.description: Column 12. The fallback literal, or the design-token role.

empty_or_error_state.description: Column 13. What renders on null, missing, or failed. From band 5.

proof_ref.description: Column 14. The story id or test assertion that proves the binding; null until it exists.

allOf.$comment: A bound row must carry a resolving pointer.
